I couldn't find the source on this machine, so this comes from counting the diff alone: the two extracted blocks scored about 13 points (the name-map `foreach`/`if` for 3, and the nested `while`/`foreach`/`if`/`&&` for 10), so `ChangeFilters` drops from 29 to about 16, still over 15, even though behaviour looks unchanged and the build plausibly still passes.
